Ralph Waldo Emerson, Representative Men.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/ralph-waldo-emerson/representative-men

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Ralph Waldo Emerson, the author, died 1882 (Wikidata Q48226; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ralph_Waldo_Emerson).

First publication of the text used: 1850 (SE colophon: 'Representative Men was published in 1850 by Ralph Waldo Emerson.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1850, before 1931. Works published before 1931 are in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: not needed. Every person named above died in 1925 or earlier, so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever its country of first publication.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: Representative Men was published in 1850 by Ralph Waldo Emerson.
- Ralph Waldo Emerson: death year 1882 from the gathered facts (Wikidata Q48226; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ralph_Waldo_Emerson).
